explanation: About 250,000 people joined the march. The famous 'dream' passage was largely improvised, and the next year, aged 35, King won the Nobel Peace Prize.

claims.text: Martin Luther King Jr. gave the 'I Have a Dream' speech at the March on Washington on 28 August 1963.
Malcolm X, Frederick Douglass and John Lewis did not give the 'I Have a Dream' speech; Douglass died in 1895, and Lewis gave a different speech at the same march.
About 250,000 people attended the March on Washington in 1963.
King improvised much of the 'dream' passage of the speech.
King won the 1964 Nobel Peace Prize at the age of 35.
